Document.description:
A document to index. `id` is optional — when omitted we derive a stable
UUIDv5 from the text so re-indexing the same content updates in place.

EmbedRequest.description: What a caller asks for, independent of which upstream serves it.

input.description: One or more texts to embed.

model.description: Override the provider's default model. Optional.

input_type.description:
Retrieval hint. Some providers (Voyage, Cohere, Gemini, Nomic) embed
queries and documents into different sub-spaces and need to be told
which side this text is. Defaults to `Document` for indexing safety.

Embedding.description: One embedding vector plus its position in the request.

seeds.description: Seed documents by external_id; results are docs reachable from them.

signals.description: Per-signal 1-based rank of this doc within each signal that matched it.

Ranking.description: One scored candidate, `index` referring to the input `documents`.

RerankRequest.description: A rerank request: score each `documents[i]` against `query`.

top_n.description: Return only the top N rankings (capped by the server's max_top_k).

ScoredPoint.description: One scored hit from a search.

filters.description: Structured filters (see `filters` module). Defaults to no filter.

bearer_auth.description: Set `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Protected routes fail closed when EMBEDDINGS_API_AUTH_BEARER is absent.
